name: Do I need to replace my existing toilet with a comfort height model?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace my existing toilet with a comfort height model?

acceptedAnswer.text: You don't always need to replace your existing toilet with a comfort height model, but it's often recommended for improved comfort and accessibility. If you or someone in your household experiences difficulty sitting down or standing up from a standard height toilet, or if you are planning to age in place, a comfort height toilet can significantly enhance bathroom usability. It's also a common upgrade during bathroom remodels to align with modern accessibility standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't always need to, but it's recommended for improved comfort and accessibility, especially if you have mobility issues or are planning to age in place.
